args.title: Catch invalid timezones during weekly rollup to prevent worker crashes
args.body:
File: src/workers/rollup.ts

Wrap the timezone-dependent weekly rollup calculation in a try/catch block so that an invalid timezone string on a single user's account logs a warning and skips that user instead of crashing the entire rollup worker and skipping all subsequent users.
